day_shape: CENTCOM marks 100 days of its Iran naval blockade (claiming $25bn in blocked oil exports), Hebron shooting attack triggers West Bank cordon, Trump accuses Iran of faking tanker attacks, Khamenei claims 'new fronts' being prepared; no OFAC or IAEA items.

threads.label: US naval blockade hits 100 days
threads.summary: CENTCOM said 100 days have passed since it resumed its 'steel wall' naval blockade of Iran, claiming it has prevented at least $25 billion in crude exports. Iran International and a former US Treasury official described trade finance strain, collapsing China 'Malaysian' crude imports, and spreading land-border disruptions via Pakistan, Iraq and Turkey.

threads.label: Hormuz tanker incidents and diplomacy
threads.summary: Trump accused Iran of faking tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz to drive up oil prices before US midterms, while Secretary Rubio spoke with Qatari PM Al Thani reaffirming US commitment to Hormuz freedom of navigation. Defa Press and IRIB quoted an IRGC Navy-linked official claiming the destruction of navigation-aid systems and strikes on three tankers had halted 'violator' vessel traffic; Turkey will host a seven-country FM meeting on the Iran-US war and Hormuz/Bab al-Mandab security.

threads.label: Hebron shooting attack and West Bank closure
threads.summary: The IDF said troops eliminated two attackers after a shooting at Judea Junction wounded five, and Netanyahu ordered Hebron cordoned off and the West Bank closed to travel. IRIB and Defa Press framed the incident as a 'martyrdom operation' in al-Khalil, claiming two Israeli soldiers killed and others wounded.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas-linked targets
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Ramadan Muhammad Ashahada Diab, head of the Popular Resistance Committees in Khan Younis, which it linked to Hamas, Hezbollah and the IRGC; a separate strike was reported in northern Gaza. Hamas health officials reported at least three killed in Israeli strikes in Gaza.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Saudi targets
threads.summary: The Houthis said they attacked Saudi Arabia's defence ministry, Aramco facilities at Yanbu and Dammam airport. Defa Press reported drone strikes and air-raid sirens in Najran and southern Saudi Arabia, with Saudi forces claiming interception.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and Iranian defiance line
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that 'new fronts' had been studied for activation if war continues, alongside a message from Ayatollah Seyyed Mostafa Khamenei on the revolution's leadership. FM Araghchi said the US has spent $11 billion over three years on missile defence for Israel and criticised Macron on the nuclear file; IRGC figures Naqdi and Mohebbi issued defiance statements.

threads.label: Iran-linked targeting of dissidents and UK ties
threads.summary: A defendant in a London court said Iranian handlers instructed him to break an Iran International journalist's arms and legs, and researchers at Semperis said an Iranian state-linked hacking group used US-hosted infrastructure to target dissidents. The Guardian reported a Reform UK billionaire donor had prior business ties to Astan Quds Razavi; a UK parliamentary question asked whether the government considers the Houthis an Iranian proxy.
